name: cmd_photo_saveMetadataToFile
description: Save Metadata to File (command `photo.saveMetadataToFile`). Params: {ids?} — writes each photo's XMP sidecar (metadata + develop settings) next to the original, merged into an existing one (other apps' data kept; an unreadable one is backed up first) → {written: [path], merged: [path], backups: [{path, backup}], failed}. Menu: Photo. Shortcut: Cmd+S.
